astronomyReference.conventions: 方位角北0°、向东顺时针；高度角从几何地平线向上。
astronomyReference.limitations: 整数度游戏读数；不计大气折射。背景星点为示意，流星与时空事件为虚构。

checks: Both actual offline role files enter the new Act IV in separate storage contexts, then run with browser networking disabled
A sees a named observation and its instrument, B sees the matching paper chart; the old circles, four-mirror rules and whole-device check are absent
An uninformed guide confirmation fails only that task, without requiring other tasks or advancing their progress
Each task asks B for its own named record: a star-chart pointing, a double-star measurement, and film/mount settings with explicit units
Following B filming data confirms photography first while both other tasks remain unsolved, and the inspection stays visible through the shutter animation
Dragging the finder crosshair and fine-adjusting B chart coordinates independently locks the requested guide star and preserves photography
A single task can be repeated and confirmed again without clearing another successful task or its settings
A double-star mismatch identifies only the current task and does not undo either completed observation
Refresh retains the same task sheets, independent completion flags, current measurements and failed-attempt counts
The measuring arm records B double-star direction and separation; its own successful confirmation finishes the third independent observation
B records an explicit human acknowledgement of the three reports, with no automatic remote state verification
A can reopen a single observation after completion, restart only this chapter, or return to the separate normal story; B remains independent
Finder controls and the reference chart remain aligned and readable on high-density screens
independentObservationsRegression.network: Separate BrowserContexts; both actual embedded role HTMLs operated with networking disabled. A temporarily reloaded online only for save testing.
independentObservationsRegression.progression: Only chapter skips prepare preceding acts. Current-act answers are obtained by reading B printed chart/catalog/film and mount table, then entered through real A dragging, wheel and physical confirmation input.
independentObservationsRegression.cooperation: A has task/equipment names and unlabelled fields, B has requested reference data and no live instrument. Each of the three tasks confirms separately and can be repeated without resetting the other two.
independentObservationsRegression.offlineLimit: Information dependency does not prove that another offline computer was actually used; prior knowledge and lucky guesses remain possible.

checks: Actual fixed-role HTMLs complete the final Act IV checkpoint and enter normal Act V with earlier records intact, then operate offline in separate contexts
The shared goal explains the investigation and the unfinished exit, while the camera cannot bypass its preparation
B has three independent witness clues and no photograph IDs or A imagery; neither role has a revealed exposure log
All eight negatives are actually inspected at high resolution; browser-pixel evidence plus B records and A loading note yield one ordered pair
Exclusion marks are reversible notes and do not hide or destroy evidence
A plausible pair with round stars and the correct field still fails on the contradictory gap; selection and other progress remain intact
Correct visual evidence in reverse order fails; physically swapping the two selected plates establishes the ordered attribution
A phone organizes only local conclusions; B receives no photo viewer, candidate traits or automatic counterpart progress
B physically places matching numbered sleeves and confirms its own hypothesis, with no partial-answer hints or automatic log reveal
Refresh preserves the hypothesis; both reconstructed phases and a real envelope drag are needed to access the existing historical exposure log
The existing dome still follows B same-name historical window log and confirms independently of the investigation
A sets the historical time through actual camera rails; failure keeps the solved investigation and the successful shutter stays in the opaque closeup
Both players can repeat only the evidence task without clearing the photograph, log or previously examined evidence
Human call acknowledgement and independently dragged doors retain the original reunion ending, including half-open-door save continuation
Fifth-act test entry and restart begin a fresh investigation while retaining normal completion and counterpart progress
High-density candidate picking and dedicated inspection remain aligned and returning from tests restores the normal ending
Actual browser loading separately verifies both v0.17 completed normal saves in clean contexts, preserving raw v8 originals and the ending under the new v9 key
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.validation: The complete normal Act IV checkpoint to Act V interaction, eight photograph inspections, wrong hypotheses, full capture, retry, doors, chapter isolation and high-density controls passed on the exact shipped build. A CDP transport timeout occurred during subsequent legacy loading; that remaining check passed separately with completed gameplay tabs released. No application code changed between these runs.

coreRunEvidence.resolvedBy: Release completed browser tabs; use fresh migration contexts and a 45s startup evaluation timeout.

fifthActAndNormalContinuation.httpVerification: The interrupted core run ended before its final network-array assertion. Legacy HTTP checks and a separate full website asset-loading test provide transport verification.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.network: Independent BrowserContexts. Actual role-specific embedded HTMLs loaded via localhost and current-act play operated offline, except explicit persistence reloads.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.cooperation: A has complete photographs and loading note; B has night records and opaque sleeves. Hypotheses are derived from actual screenshot pixels and visible records, never from the validator or injected current-act solutions.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.offlineLimit: Previously known answers or lucky guesses remain possible in an offline game.
fifthActAndNormalContinuation.artStatus: Clearly labelled prototype evidence images and interfaces; final art remains to be produced.
